4.3.1.17 Handling of acknowledgment events
As a general rule, the acknowledgment events DataWriteCompletedEvent and
DataSendCompletedEvent shall be raised immediately after the sending to all re-
ceivers has been performed and in case of Inter-ECU communication all acknowledg-
ments from COM have been received.
[SWS_Rte_01287]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00122, SRS_Rte_00018
⌈A DataSendCompletedEvent that references a RunnableEntity and is refer-
enced by a WaitPoint shall be an invalid configuration which is rejected by the RTE
generator.⌋
[SWS_Rte_04640]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00051, SRS_Rte_00122
⌈The RTE generator shall reject the configuration if the VariableDataPrototype
referenced by a DataSendCompletedEvent does not have transmission acknowl-
edgment enabled.⌋
As part of the implementation detailed rules for the following communication scenarios
have to be considered:
Intra-Partition communication
[SWS_Rte_08017]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00122
⌈For intra-partition communication with implicit dataWriteAccess the DataWrite-
CompletedEvent shall be fired if and only if a task/ISR2 terminates and the write-
back copy actions to the global RTE-buffer are completed. The transmission status
shall be RTE_E_TRANSMIT_ACK and can be collected with Rte_IFeedback API.⌋
